# Model-step record contract

`contract.json` is the one example of the stored record, `carrick.matched/2`:
the ends (serving sides and call sites) the cloud's model step found after
the scan, in the index's own key terms. The cloud adds them to each service's
rows at read time (`withModelRows`) and the index's matcher pairs them. The
cloud pins the same bytes by the same sha256
(`9c45f54cdf16551799245b5f73c9df09ecd80b1cc82a71d65e3b329e99b77a08`;
carrick-cloud `lambdas/_shared/model_record.contract.json`, generated by
`lambdas/_shared/scripts/make_model_record_contract.mjs`), and
`tests/matched_record_contract_test.rs` fails if either side changes. The data
is invented.

## Top level

- `schema`: `"carrick.matched/2"`.
- `repo`: `owner/name`. `commit`: 40 hex, the indexed commit.
- `run`: `id`, `mode` (`full` or `changed_files`), `base_commit`, `model`,
  `brief_sha256`, `started_at`, `finished_at`, and optional `coverage`
  (`kinds` with `endpoints` and `calls` per kind, `stopped_by`, `turns`,
  `usd`), read off what the model sent. It is no target.
- `engine`: `status`, optional `reason`, `ms`, `scanner_version`.
- `ends`: a list of ends. `dropped`: a count per reason, non-zero only.

## An end

- `side`: `call` or `endpoint`. `protocol`: `http`, `graphql`, `socket` or
  `pubsub` (queues are pubsub topics). `kind`: `route`, `graphql_field`,
  `procedure`, `topic`, `event`, `queue`, `table`, `database_function`,
  `function` or `other` (display only, never part of a key).
- Key fields, as `OperationKey` keys the protocol: http `method` (upper
  case, `ALL` for a serving side that answers every method) and `path`, or
  `procedure {path}` with `path` empty; graphql `name` and `gql_kind`
  (`query`, `mutation`, `subscription`); socket `name` and `direction`
  (`client_to_server`, `server_to_client`, `unknown`); pubsub `name`.
- `file` (repo-relative, no leading `/`, no `..`, not under `node_modules`),
  `line`, `line_sha256`, `confidence` (`stated` or `inferred`), `basis`
  (`text`, `symbol`, `config`), `carried_from` (a commit or null).

## Hashes

- `line_sha256` is the sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the line, trimmed, without
  its newline.
- `id` is the first 16 hex of the sha256 of side, protocol, method, path,
  name, gql_kind, direction, procedure path, file and line, joined by `\n`
  (an absent field is empty).

`src/matched_pass.rs` reads a v2 record as no pairs and leaves it untouched
until the engine pass reads ends (MR-T).
